Unit 5 — The Axe & The Cave

The game changes genre: an item grants capability, a lever fires an event, and a scene load flips gravity. Three lessons that turn your overworld RPG into a platformer — by decoupling cause from effect.

Lessons

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
5.1aThe Axe: Item Pickups & Inventory Boolscapability items — a pickup that is not a number
5.2aThe Door: Breaking In with EventsLever.Interact, UnityEvents, rules changed with no code
5.3aInto the Cave: Scene Loading & Mode SwitchLoadScene, the scene-name branch, gravityScale flip

Concepts this unit owns

Three ideas the exam loves: right-sizing data (bool vs counter vs list), abstraction through events (the lever never names the door), and instance vs persistent state (what survives a scene load). CED: AAP-2 (managing complexity with abstraction — the UnityEvent), AAP-3, CRD-2.
